note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs export records with B/L numbers, ports and destinations (Morocco, Nigeria) exist for 2025-03-27 through 2026-02-13, so the company is a real, active exporter of FRP tanks/vessels and gas-scrubber components. HS discrepancy: declared HS 842139 (filtering/purifying machinery) does not match the observed shipment codes — 84219900 (parts of filtering machinery), 84198990 (other machinery for temperature treatment) and 85044090 (static converters) — so per project rules the company is retained and the factual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (accepted_hs_corrected), not rejected. Role: manufacturer_trader is plausible (FRP fabrication plus trading of control panels/PPR items), but the customs data alone does not settle manufacturer vs trader. Domestic supply evidence: NOT established — no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split could be retrieved (zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403, tofler returned 404, IndiaMART returned HTTP 429, and the web_search backend was unavailable with 'Connection refused' throughout). Domestic status is therefore 'unknown', not 'none_found': absence of retrieved records here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views and are recorded as null rather than estimated.
